sentences.en: Hi, I'm Andrew Ross Sorkin.
sentences.zh: 嗨，我是安德鲁·罗斯·索尔金。

sentences.en: I cover business and policy for DealBook, a daily newsletter at the New York Times.
sentences.zh: 我是《纽约时报》每日新闻通讯 DealBook 的商业与政策记者。

sentences.en: On November 18th, I'm going to be interviewing some of the most consequential leaders in business, politics, and culture, including J.D.
sentences.zh: 11 月 18 日，我将在纽约市 DealBook 峰会的现场，采访商业、政治和文化领域最具影响力的领袖，包括 J.D.

sentences.en: Vance, Elon Musk, Christine Lagarde, Zilran Mondani, and many others, live on stage at the DealBook Summit in New York City.
sentences.zh: 万斯、埃隆·马斯克、克里斯蒂娜·拉加德、齐尔兰·蒙达尼以及许多其他人。

sentences.en: You can watch some of these unguarded, unfiltered conversations as they happen.
sentences.zh: 你可以实时观看其中一些毫无保留、未经过滤的对话。

sentences.en: We're going to be live-streaming select interviews for anyone to watch, free, at nytimes.com on November 18th.
sentences.zh: 11 月 18 日，我们将在 nytimes.com 上直播精选采访，供所有人免费观看。

sentences.en: If you're not already a subscriber, you can download the New York Times app to watch and get a month of free access to all of our journalism.
sentences.zh: 如果你还不是订阅者，可以下载《纽约时报》应用程序进行观看，并免费获得一个月的所有新闻内容访问权限。

sentences.en: I hope you'll tune in.
sentences.zh: 希望大家准时收看。

sentences.en: You won't want to miss it.
sentences.zh: 你一定不想错过。

sentences.en: Tom?
sentences.zh: 汤姆？

sentences.en: That's okay.
sentences.zh: 没关系。

sentences.en: Nice to meet you.
sentences.zh: 很高兴认识你。

sentences.en: So on Monday, I left the New York Times office with Daily Producer Claire Tennesketter.
sentences.zh: 所以在周一，我和《每日秀》制片人克莱尔·坦内斯凯特一起离开了《纽约时报》办公室。

sentences.en: Can you tell me where we're walking?
sentences.zh: 你能告诉我们现在正走向哪里吗？

sentences.en: So we're heading out of the West 4th Street station.
sentences.zh: 我们正从西第四街地铁站走出来。

sentences.en: We took the subway down to Washington Square Park in the heart of NYU's campus in Greenwich Village.
sentences.zh: 我们坐地铁来到了位于格林威治村纽约大学校园中心的华盛顿广场公园。

sentences.en: It's an iconic park in Manhattan filled with students, musicians, dogs, people streaming through at all hours of the day.
sentences.zh: 这是曼哈顿标志性的公园，到处都是学生、音乐家、狗狗，以及全天候川流不息的人群。

sentences.en: It's hosted political rallies over the years, hosted protests.
sentences.zh: 多年来，这里举办过许多政治集会和抗议活动。

sentences.en: This is where we're supposed to go in.
sentences.zh: 这就是我们应该进去的地方。

sentences.en: And on Monday night, thank you.
sentences.zh: 而在周一晚上，谢谢你们。

sentences.en: Here's Elizabeth Warren.
sentences.zh: 伊丽莎白·沃伦来了。

sentences.en: Come talk to me.
sentences.zh: 来跟我谈谈。

sentences.en: It was the site of a big rally for Elizabeth Warren, where she was going to give one of the biggest speeches of her presidential campaign so far.
sentences.zh: 这里曾是伊丽莎白·沃伦大型集会的地点，她将在那里发表她迄今为止总统竞选活动中最重磅的演讲之一。

sentences.en: Elizabeth Warren.
sentences.zh: 伊丽莎白·沃伦。

sentences.en: She may even have gone to the Starbucks that you attend.
sentences.zh: 她甚至可能去过你常去的星巴克。

sentences.en: Elizabeth Warren is in New York City, folks.
sentences.zh: 伙计们，伊丽莎白·沃伦在纽约市。

sentences.en: Woo!
sentences.zh: 呜呼！

sentences.en: From the New York Times, I'm Michael Barbaro.
sentences.zh: 我是来自《纽约时报》的迈克尔·巴巴罗。

sentences.en: This is The Daily.
sentences.zh: 这是《每日新闻》。

sentences.en: Today.
sentences.zh: 今天。

sentences.en: It's hard to ignore the size of her crowd.
sentences.zh: 人们很难忽视她的人气规模。

sentences.en: With crowds of 15,000 to 20,000 people.
sentences.zh: 集会人数达到了 1.5 万到 2 万人。

sentences.en: Originally scheduled at the Wamuu Theater, this town hall grew three times the anticipated size.
sentences.zh: 这场原本计划在瓦穆剧院举行的市民大会，规模比预期扩大了三倍。

sentences.en: Her campaign events frequently dwarfed that of her Democratic rivals.
sentences.zh: 她的竞选活动规模经常让民主党竞争对手黯然失色。

sentences.en: Today in Seattle, Elizabeth Warren saw one of the largest crowds of her campaign to date.
sentences.zh: 今天在西雅图，伊丽莎白·沃伦迎来了她竞选至今最大规模的人群之一。

sentences.en: Thomas Kaplan.
sentences.zh: 托马斯·卡普兰。

sentences.en: On the growing phenomenon that is an Elizabeth Warren rally.
sentences.zh: 关于伊丽莎白·沃伦集会这一日益壮大的现象。

sentences.en: It's Friday, September 20th.
sentences.zh: 今天是 9 月 20 日，星期五。

sentences.en: Hey, Claire.
sentences.zh: 嘿，克莱尔。

sentences.en: So I just arrived in Washington Square Park.
sentences.zh: 我刚到华盛顿广场公园。

sentences.en: It's about 5.45.
sentences.zh: 大约 5 点 45 分。

sentences.en: Music is really loud.
sentences.zh: 音乐声音非常大。

sentences.en: I entered to 9 to 5, Dolly Parton.
sentences.zh: 我伴随着多莉·帕顿的《从九到五》入场。

sentences.en: Now we're transitioning.
sentences.zh: 现在我们正在过渡。

sentences.en: This event is like interestingly constructed around this iconic New York City landmark of the Washington Square Park arch.
sentences.zh: 这场活动巧妙地围绕着纽约市的标志性地标——华盛顿广场公园拱门构建。

sentences.en: And there's an American flag in the middle of the arch.
sentences.zh: 拱门中间挂着一面美国国旗。

sentences.en: And these two vertical blue Warren sides on either side of the of the arch.
sentences.zh: 拱门两侧各有两个垂直的蓝色沃伦标牌。

sentences.en: And just a lot of a lot of people milling around some marijuana smoke.
sentences.zh: 周围有很多闲逛的人，空气中还有一些大麻味。

sentences.en: Not going to lie.
sentences.zh: 说实话。

sentences.en: So Tom, the reason we were interested in going to Senator Warren's rally is because for weeks now,
sentences.zh: 汤姆，我们有兴趣去参议员沃伦集会的原因是，几个星期以来，

sentences.en: we've been hearing that her crowd sizes are getting bigger and bigger and that there's something unique about these events.
sentences.zh: 我们一直听说她的集会规模越来越大，而且这些活动有某种独特之处。

sentences.en: And when we think back to 2016, we know that Donald Trump's rallies were at the center of his appeal.
sentences.zh: 当我们回想起 2016 年时，我们知道唐纳德·特朗普的集会是他吸引支持的核心。

sentences.en: And in the end, kind of at the center of his victory.
sentences.zh: 最终，某种程度上也是他获胜的核心。

sentences.en: And the question has always been, could a Democrat match that in 2020?
sentences.zh: 而一直以来的问题是，民主党人能在 2020 年匹敌这一点吗？

sentences.en: And it's starting to feel like possibly Elizabeth Warren's rallies are beginning to accomplish something like that.
sentences.zh: 现在人们开始觉得，伊丽莎白·沃伦的集会可能正在实现类似的效果。

sentences.en: And that you have to be there and attend it to kind of understand why.
sentences.zh: 你必须亲临现场参加，才能明白其中的原因。

sentences.en: Yeah, that's right.
sentences.zh: 是的，没错。

sentences.en: I've been covering Elizabeth Warren's campaign and going to her rallies for months.
sentences.zh: 我几个月来一直在报道伊丽莎白·沃伦的竞选并参加她的集会。

sentences.en: And over that time, they've grown bigger and bigger.
sentences.zh: 在那段时间里，集会规模变得越来越大。

sentences.en: But beyond the size, they've kind of taken on a life of their own.
sentences.zh: 但除了规模之外，它们似乎也开始拥有了属于自己的生命力。

sentences.en: They have their own rituals, their own vocabulary.
sentences.zh: 它们有自己的仪式，自己的词汇。

sentences.en: They have their own traditions.
sentences.zh: 它们有自己的传统。

sentences.en: It's almost as if they've become something beyond a political rally.
sentences.zh: 几乎可以说是超越了普通政治集会的范畴。

sentences.en: They've really become a defining feature of her presidential campaign.
sentences.zh: 它们真正成为了她总统竞选的决定性特征。

sentences.en: Okay, so then the official program gets underway.
sentences.zh: 好的，接着官方议程开始了。

sentences.en: My name is Maria Martinez, and I'm part of the national team of organizers with the presidential campaign of Elizabeth Warren.
sentences.zh: 我叫玛丽亚·马丁内斯，我是伊丽莎白·沃伦总统竞选团队全国组织者团队的一员。

sentences.en: There are these introductory speeches by a pretty diverse group of women.
sentences.zh: 有一组背景相当多元的女性发表了开场演讲。

sentences.en: Thank you all so, so much for being here tonight.
sentences.zh: 非常非常感谢大家今晚来到这里。

sentences.en: And then there was this moment that kind of struck me where it almost felt like the priest talking to everybody in a church when...
sentences.zh: 然后有这样一个时刻触动了我，感觉就像牧师在教堂里对大家说话，当时……

sentences.en: I'm going to give you all a minute.
sentences.zh: 我要给你们大家一分钟时间。

sentences.en: I really want you all to talk to each other, get to know each other...
sentences.zh: 我真的希望你们互相交谈，互相了解……

sentences.en: This person on stage asks everybody in the crowd to turn to the person next to them and introduce themselves, just like they do inside church.
sentences.zh: 台上这个人要求人群中的每个人转向身边的陌生人并做自我介绍，就像他们在教堂里做的那样。

sentences.en: There was almost like an insistence on civility.
sentences.zh: 几乎有一种对文明礼貌的坚持。

sentences.en: Yeah.
sentences.zh: 是的。

sentences.en: All right, everyone, let's bring it back in.
sentences.zh: 好了，各位，我们把注意力收回来。

sentences.en: And it's something we've seen throughout her campaign.
sentences.zh: 这是我们在她的整个竞选过程中一直看到的情况。

sentences.en: I mean, reporters always try to bait candidates into criticizing their rivals.
sentences.zh: 我的意思是，记者总是试图引诱候选人去批评他们的对手。

sentences.en: And she is very careful to avoid that.
sentences.zh: 而她非常小心地避免这样做。

sentences.en: And I think that kind of attitude you can see at her events and in her crowds as well is very much in keeping with the way she has approached her campaign.
sentences.zh: 我认为你在她的活动和人群中也能看到这种态度，这与她开展竞选的方式高度一致。

sentences.en: Without further ado, U.S.
sentences.zh: 废话不多说，美国

sentences.en: Senator Elizabeth Warren.
sentences.zh: 参议员伊丽莎白·沃伦。

sentences.en: Okay, so after these introductions and that church moment, Warren takes a stage.
sentences.zh: 好的，在这些开场白和那个教堂般的时刻之后，沃伦登上了舞台。

sentences.en: Yeah, and she comes on stage in this sort of triumphant moment to begin her speech.
sentences.zh: 是的，她以一种胜利者的姿态走上舞台开始演讲。

sentences.en: Both hands are up in the air.
sentences.zh: 双手高高举起。

sentences.en: It's like a full-body wave.
sentences.zh: 就像是一个全身心的挥手致意。

sentences.en: He's very energetic.
sentences.zh: 她非常有活力。

sentences.en: It's a sort of very vigorous entrance.
sentences.zh: 这是一种非常充满活力的出场。

sentences.en: Warren is on stage.
sentences.zh: 沃伦在舞台上。

sentences.en: She's wearing a purple jacket.
sentences.zh: 她穿着一件紫色夹克。

sentences.en: Vigorously.
sentences.zh: 充满活力地。

sentences.en: And then...
sentences.zh: 然后……

sentences.en: Okay, she's about to start.
sentences.zh: 好吧，她要开始了。

sentences.en: She settles behind the podium to begin this speech.
sentences.zh: 她站在讲台后定下神来，准备开始演讲。

sentences.en: And the first thing she does is make clear why she chose this location.
sentences.zh: 她做的第一件事就是阐明她为什么选择这个地点。

sentences.en: I wanted to give this speech right here.
sentences.zh: 我想把这场演讲就在这里发表。

sentences.en: And not because of the arch behind me or the president that this square is named for.
sentences.zh: 不是因为我身后的拱门，也不是因为这个广场以之命名的那位总统。

sentences.en: Nope.
sentences.zh: 不。

sentences.en: We are not here today because of famous arches or famous men.
sentences.zh: 我们今天来这里不是因为著名的拱门或著名的人物。

sentences.en: And she says...
sentences.zh: 她说……

sentences.en: We're not here because of men at all.
sentences.zh: 我们来这里根本不是为了男人。

sentences.en: We're not here because of men at all.
sentences.zh: 我们来这里根本不是为了男人。

sentences.en: And she says...
sentences.zh: 然后她说……

sentences.en: We're here because of some hardworking women.
sentences.zh: 我们来这里是为了那些辛勤工作的女性。

sentences.en: And then she launches into this story of a horrible fire that took place near Washington Square Park.
sentences.zh: 接着她开始讲述华盛顿广场公园附近发生的一场可怕火灾的故事。

sentences.en: The story of the Triangle Shirtwaist Factory fire.
sentences.zh: 三角衬衫厂火灾的故事。

sentences.en: Here's what I want you to hear.
sentences.zh: 这是我想让你们听听的。

sentences.en: It was March 25th, 1911.
It's a Saturday.
sentences.zh: 那是一个星期六。

sentences.en: And at about 4.45 in the afternoon, people walking through this very park looked up and saw black smoke billowing into the sky.
sentences.zh: 大约在下午 4 点 45 分，穿过这座公园的人们抬起头，看到滚滚黑烟直冲云霄。

sentences.en: People were trapped.
sentences.zh: 人们被困住了。

sentences.en: The fire department's ladders couldn't reach high enough up in the building.
sentences.zh: 消防部门的云梯够不到大楼的高层。

sentences.en: And as people on the ground stood in shock silence, a woman jumped.
sentences.zh: 就在地面上的人们震惊得说不出话时，一个女人跳了下去。

sentences.en: Ultimately, 146 people died, most of them women.
sentences.zh: 最终，146 人丧生，其中大多数是女性。

sentences.en: Everyone knew about these probleMs.
sentences.zh: 每个人都知道这些问题。

sentences.en: But the fat profits were making New York's factory owners rich, and they had no plans to give that up.
sentences.zh: 但巨额利润让纽约的工厂老板们大发横财，他们根本不打算放弃这些。

sentences.en: And this became sort of a defining event that ended up leading to changes in workplace safety.
sentences.zh: 这成了一个决定性的事件，最终推动了工作场所安全的变革。

sentences.en: The tragic story of the Triangle Factory fire is a story about power.
sentences.zh: 三角工厂火灾的悲惨故事是一个关于权力的故事。

sentences.en: She tells this story at the beginning of the rally to make the point that the way to fight corruption,
sentences.zh: 她在集会开始时讲这个故事，是为了说明打击腐败的方法，

sentences.en: the way to bring about big structural change, as she calls it, is for people to band together.
sentences.zh: 正如她所说，带来重大结构性变革的方法，就是人们团结在一起。

sentences.en: That's the point.
sentences.zh: 这就是重点。

sentences.en: Right, so this serves as a prologue to the main event of her speech, which is all about corruption today.
sentences.zh: 没错，这充当了她演讲主旨的序言，而主旨全关于当今的腐败问题。

sentences.en: Right.
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: Now, when you see a government that works great for those with money and connections and doesn't work for much of anyone else, that's corruption, plain and simple,
sentences.zh: 现在，当你看到一个为有钱人和有关系的人极力运转、却对其他大多数人毫无作用的政府时，这就是腐败，简而言之，

sentences.en: and we need to call it out for what it is.
sentences.zh: 我们需要直言不讳地指出它的本质。

sentences.en: And it's this idea that really is at the center of her campaign, that corruption permeates the political system.
sentences.zh: 正是这种观点构成了她竞选的核心，即腐败渗透到了整个政治体系中。

sentences.en: Americans are killed by floods and fires in a rapidly warming planet.
sentences.zh: 在快速变暖的地球上，美国人正死于洪水和火灾。

sentences.en: Why?
sentences.zh: 为什么？

sentences.en: Because huge fossil fuel corporations have bought off our government.
sentences.zh: 因为庞大的化石燃料公司收买了我们的政府。

sentences.en: Americans are killed with unthinkable speed and efficiency in our streets and our stores and our schools.
sentences.zh: 美国人正以不可思议的速度和效率死在我们的街道、商店和学校里。

sentences.en: Why?
sentences.zh: 为什么？

sentences.en: Because the gun industry has bought off our government.
sentences.zh: 因为枪支行业收买了我们的政府。

sentences.en: Right.
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: And listening to this, I felt like I finally understood the kind of unified theory of the Warren campaign,
sentences.zh: 听了这些，我觉得我终于理解了沃伦竞选团队的某种统一理论，

sentences.en: which is that no matter what issue you care about, it is connected to this baseline problem, in her telling, of corruption, of entrenched forces, of lobbyists,
sentences.zh: 那就是无论你关心什么议题，在她的讲述中，它都与这个根源问题相连——腐败、既得利益势力、说客，

sentences.en: of the revolving door in Washington.
sentences.zh: 以及华盛顿的旋转门机制。

sentences.en: And that's her basic diagnosis of what ails the United States, and it's what animates her campaign.
sentences.zh: 这就是她对美国病症的基本诊断，也是她竞选活动的动力源泉。

sentences.en: That's exactly right.
sentences.zh: 完全正确。

sentences.en: It all comes back to this sort of central broken system that, in her view, needs to be fixed.
sentences.zh: 这一切都归结为这种在她看来需要修复的、核心破碎的系统。

sentences.en: Right.
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: I find myself thinking that the most successful candidates always do this.
sentences.zh: 我不禁想到，最成功的候选人总是这样做。

sentences.en: They create an umbrella message that is highly digestible and kind of punchy.
sentences.zh: 他们创造了一个高度易懂且极具冲击力的总体口号。

sentences.en: You know, make America great again, right?
sentences.zh: 你知道的，让美国再次伟大，对吧？

sentences.en: Except, in her telling, it's kind of make America less corrupt.
sentences.zh: 只不过，在她的讲述中，有点像是让美国减少腐败。

sentences.en: I guess the difference from Trump is what Warren says next.
sentences.zh: 我想她与特朗普的不同之处在于沃伦接下来所说的话。

sentences.en: Yeah.
sentences.zh: 是的。

sentences.en: What she says next is, I got a plan for that.
sentences.zh: 她接下来所说的是，我对此有个计划。

sentences.en: I have a plan for that.
sentences.zh: 我对此有一个计划。

sentences.en: And she has lots of plans on all sorts of different subjects.
sentences.zh: 她针对各种不同的主题都有大量的计划。

sentences.en: Universal pre-K for every three-year-old and four-year-old in America.
sentences.zh: 为全美每一个三岁和四岁儿童提供普及型学前教育。

sentences.en: She has a plan for universal child care.
sentences.zh: 她有一项关于普及托儿服务的计划。

sentences.en: We can make technical school, community college, and four-year college tuition-free for everyone who wants to get an education.
sentences.zh: 我们可以为所有想接受教育的人提供免费的技术学校、社区学院和四年制大学教育。

sentences.en: And to make public college tuition-free, she has a plan on housing.
sentences.zh: 为了让公立大学免学费，她还制定了一套住房计划。

sentences.en: And my plan respects the rights of Native Americans to protect their lands and be good stewards of this earth.
sentences.zh: 我的计划尊重美洲原住民保护其土地并做好地球管理者的权利。

sentences.en: The list goes on and on and on and on.
sentences.zh: 这样的例子数不胜数。

sentences.en: I want to talk about how the crowd reacts to those plans.
sentences.zh: 我想谈谈人群对这些计划的反应。

sentences.en: Because I don't think I've ever experienced so much rapturous applause to the word plan.

sentences.zh: 汤姆，帮我理解一下，每个人来到这里到底是因为什么动力？

sentences.en: So I think Elizabeth Warren connects with a lot of people, inspires a lot of voters, and they want this personal interaction with her, and they're willing to wait for it.
sentences.zh: 所以我觉得伊丽莎白·沃伦能和许多人产生共鸣，激励了许多选民，他们想要与她进行这种面对面的互动，他们愿意为此等待。

sentences.en: I talked to one woman a few months ago after she met Warren in the selfie line.
sentences.zh: 几个月前，我在沃伦的自拍队伍后采访了一位女士。

sentences.en: She told me that brief interaction was one of the highlights of her life.
sentences.zh: 她告诉我，那次简短的互动是她一生中最精彩的时刻之一。

sentences.en: It was just, like, an amazing feeling.
sentences.zh: 那种感觉简直太棒了。

sentences.en: Like, I just started jumping like a little kid.
sentences.zh: 就像，我直接像小孩子一样跳了起来。

sentences.en: Seriously.
sentences.zh: 真的。

sentences.en: Like, I love her.
sentences.zh: 就像，我爱她。

sentences.en: I'm excited.
sentences.zh: 我很兴奋。

sentences.en: I saw you the moment you saw her.
sentences.zh: 在你看到她的那一刻，我也看到了你。

sentences.en: And she said, we're going to make it.
sentences.zh: 她说，我们会成功的。

sentences.en: We're going to make it together.
sentences.zh: 我们会一起成功的。

sentences.en: And I think people feel that they're part of a movement.
sentences.zh: 我觉得人们会觉得自己是一场运动的一部分。

sentences.en: They're part of something bigger than just going to a political event, cheering for a candidate.
sentences.zh: 他们参与的不仅仅是一场政治活动、为候选人欢呼，而是更宏大的事物。

sentences.en: And by waiting in the selfie line, by getting that picture, by having that brief interaction, they are sort of claiming their place in that bigger movement.
sentences.zh: 通过在自拍队伍中等待、拍到那张照片、进行那次短暂的互动，他们某种程度上确立了自己在那个宏大运动中的地位。

sentences.en: And it means a lot to people.
sentences.zh: 这对人们意义重大。

sentences.en: And what are you going to do with your photo?
sentences.zh: 你打算怎么处理你的照片？

sentences.en: I am going to put it on Twitter, Facebook, Instagram.
sentences.zh: 我打算把它发到推特、脸书和照片墙上。

sentences.en: And for the Warren campaign, this is strategic.
sentences.zh: 对沃伦的竞选团队来说，这是有战略意义的。

sentences.en: This is something that is extraordinarily useful to have all these people who get their picture taken with Elizabeth Warren and then go post it on Facebook, post it on Instagram.
sentences.zh: 让所有这些人与伊丽莎白·沃伦合影，然后发到脸书和照片墙上，这是极其有用的一招。

sentences.en: And what do you hope happens after you share it?
sentences.zh: 你希望分享之后发生什么？

sentences.en: Why share it?
sentences.zh: 为什么要分享？

sentences.en: Because we need to know that she will be the president.
sentences.zh: 因为我们需要知道她会成为总统。

sentences.en: And spread the word about her campaign.
sentences.zh: 并宣传她的竞选活动。

sentences.en: And that's super valuable for a campaign to have that kind of organic advertising.
sentences.zh: 对于一个竞选团队来说，拥有这种有机宣传是非常宝贵的。

sentences.en: Among voters.
sentences.zh: 在选民当中。

sentences.en: And it's something they've really kind of leaned into as a point of distinction with other candidates.
sentences.zh: 而且他们确实把这一点作为与其他候选人区别开来的亮点。

sentences.en: So the argument goes, the typical presidential candidate, they give their speech, they leave, they go to some closed door ritzy fundraiser with a bunch of rich people.
sentences.zh: 所以论点是这样的，典型的总统候选人，他们发表演讲，离开，然后去参加某个有钱人云集的闭门奢华筹款活动。

sentences.en: Instead, she stays at her events.
sentences.zh: 相反，她留在她的活动现场。

sentences.en: She meets everyone who wants to stay and meet her and takes pictures with them.
sentences.zh: 她会见每一个想留下来见她的人，并与他们合影。

sentences.en: And that contrast between what you might expect from a candidate and what you see with Warren, I think, is something the campaign has really embraced.
sentences.zh: 我认为，你对候选人的预期与你在沃伦身上看到的这种反差，是竞选团队真正拥抱的东西。

sentences.en: So it feels like the campaign has come to understand that the selfie line may be just as important as anything else that happens in the rally.
sentences.zh: 所以感觉竞选团队已经开始明白，自拍队伍可能和集会中发生的任何其他事情一样重要。

sentences.en: And that you can see that in the way that they're approaching this.
sentences.zh: 从他们对待这件事的方式中，你就能看出来。

sentences.en: Definitely.
sentences.zh: 绝对是的。

sentences.en: Time is a precious commodity for a presidential candidate.
sentences.zh: 时间对总统候选人来说是宝贵的商品。

sentences.en: And Warren is spending an awful lot of time doing this.
sentences.zh: 而沃伦花了很多时间在做这件事。

sentences.en: Oh, street cleaners.
sentences.zh: 哦，清扫车。

sentences.en: Oh, man.
sentences.zh: 天哪。

sentences.en: Your laptop's away.
sentences.zh: 你的笔记本电脑收起来了。

sentences.en: Are you done, done?
sentences.zh: 你彻底搞定了吗？

sentences.en: I'm sort of done.
sentences.zh: 我差不多搞定了。

sentences.en: I'm probably going to do one more like layer of polishing later, but I'm almost out of battery.
sentences.zh: 我可能待会儿还要做最后一轮润色，但我快没电了。

sentences.en: And are you really going to stay?
sentences.zh: 你真的要留下来吗？

sentences.en: I think I'm going to stay till the end.
sentences.zh: 我想我要留到最后。

sentences.en: I am definitely getting, like, slightly softer in my resolve.
sentences.zh: 我的决心确实有点动摇了。

sentences.en: Okay, so it's like 1120.
sentences.zh: 好吧，现在大概是11点20分。

sentences.en: I'm tired.
sentences.zh: 我累了。

sentences.en: I'm going to go home, Tom.
sentences.zh: 我要回家了，汤姆。

sentences.en: I'll see you at the next Warren rally.
sentences.zh: 我们在下一场沃伦集会上见吧。

sentences.en: Sounds great.
sentences.zh: 听起来不错。

sentences.en: Get some sleep.
sentences.zh: 睡个好觉。

sentences.en: So in the end, to get everyone their selfie, it took almost four hours.
sentences.zh: 所以最后，为了让每个人都拍到自拍，花了将近四个小时。

sentences.en: Let's get excited about this.
sentences.zh: 让我们为此兴奋起来吧。

sentences.en: As I left, I was starting to think that this is the thing that people talk about when they
sentences.zh: 当我离开时，我开始觉得这就是人们在谈论

sentences.en: talk about the Elizabeth Warren rally as a phenomenon, and that it begins to help explain her entire candidacy.
sentences.zh: 伊丽莎白·沃伦集会是一种“现象”时所指的事情，这开始有助于解释她的整个参选历程。

sentences.en: Yeah.
sentences.zh: 是的。

sentences.en: Now, looking at campaigns in the past, getting big crowds and having these big, exciting events
sentences.zh: 现在，回顾过去的竞选活动，吸引到大批人群并举办这些盛大、激动人心的活动

sentences.en: doesn't necessarily translate into winning in Iowa or New Hampshire or winning at all.
sentences.zh: 并不一定能转化为在艾奥瓦州或新罕布什尔州的胜利，或者根本无法保证胜利。

sentences.en: You can look back at Howard Dean.
sentences.zh: 你可以回想一下霍华德·迪恩。

sentences.en: You can look back at Bernie Sanders in 2016.
sentences.zh: 你可以回想一下2016年的伯尼·桑德斯。

sentences.en: Right, huge crowds.
sentences.zh: 没错，庞大的人群。

sentences.en: Right, and having a big crowd, who knows what that translates to months from now when people start to vote.
sentences.zh: 没错，拥有庞大的人群，谁知道几个月后人们开始投票时，这会转化为什结果。

sentences.en: And a big crowd in New York, by the way, what that means in Iowa, people can speculate about that.
sentences.zh: 顺便说一句，纽约的大批人群在艾奥瓦州意味着什么，人们对此可以进行推测。

sentences.en: But it certainly is distinctive what she's doing.
sentences.zh: 但她所做的事情无疑是与众不同的。

sentences.en: And if she goes on to become the Democratic nominee, it will have had a lot to do with how she's approached these rallies.
sentences.zh: 如果她继续成为民主党候选人，这将在很大程度上与她对待这些集会的方式有关。

sentences.en: Thank you very much.
sentences.zh: 非常感谢。

sentences.en: Thank you.
sentences.zh: 谢谢你们。

sentences.en: After Warren's rally in Washington Square Park, President Trump challenged her campaign's
sentences.zh: 在沃伦于华盛顿广场公园举行集会后，特朗普总统在没有引用证据的情况下，对她竞选团队

sentences.en: estimated crowd size of 20,000 people without citing evidence and said that, quote, anybody could attract a major crowd in New York City.
sentences.zh: 估计的2万名集会人数提出了质疑，并表示，引述一下，“任何人在纽约市都能吸引大批群众”。

sentences.en: We'll be right back.
sentences.zh: 我们马上回来。

sentences.en: Here's what else you need to know today.
sentences.zh: 以下是你今天需要了解的其他内容。

sentences.en: An unusual complaint from a whistleblower inside the intelligence community has triggered a new standoff between the White House and congressional Democrats.
sentences.zh: 情报界内部一名举报人的非同寻常的投诉，引发了白宫与国会民主党人之间的新一轮对峙。

sentences.en: The complaint apparently involves a promise made by President Trump during a conversation with
sentences.zh: 这项投诉显然涉及特朗普总统在与

sentences.en: an unidentified foreign leader, which was deemed alarming enough by the inspector general for the intelligence community to notify Congress of the complaint's existence.
sentences.zh: 一位未具名的外国领导人交谈时作出的承诺，情报界督察长认为该承诺性质足够严重，足以惊动国会并告知其该投诉的存在。

sentences.en: But the acting director of national intelligence, Joseph Maguire, a Trump appointee, has refused to turn the whistleblower's report over to Congress.
sentences.zh: 但代理国家情报总监、特朗普任命的约瑟夫·马奎尔拒绝将举报人的报告交予国会。

sentences.en: That prompted the chairman of the House Intelligence Committee, Adam Schiff, to subpoena
sentences.zh: 这促使众议院情报委员会主席亚当·希夫向

sentences.en: Maguire to appear before his committee to explain his actions.
sentences.zh: 马奎尔发出传票，要求他出席委员会解释其行为。

sentences.en: So exactly how many times have you darkened your skin with makeup in an act that you have yourself described as racist?
sentences.zh: 那么，你究竟有多少次用化妆品把皮肤涂黑，而你自己的行为却被形容为种族主义？

sentences.en: I shared the moments that I recollected, but I recognize that it is something absolutely unacceptable to do.
sentences.zh: 我分享了我回想起来的时刻，但我认识到这是绝对不能做的事。

sentences.en: And I appreciate calling it makeup, but it was blackface.
sentences.zh: 我很感激把它称为化妆，但这其实是涂黑脸。

sentences.en: And that is just not right.
sentences.zh: 这绝对是不对的。

sentences.en: On Thursday, Canadian Prime Minister Justin Trudeau acknowledged multiple occasions on which
sentences.zh: 周四，加拿大总理贾斯廷·特鲁多承认，他曾多次

sentences.en: he dressed in brownface and blackface, a racist caricature that could now endanger his re-election campaign.
sentences.zh: 把脸涂成棕色和黑色，这是一种种族主义讽刺形象，现在可能会危及他的连任竞选。

sentences.en: It is something that people who live with the kind of discrimination that far too many people
sentences.zh: 这是许多人经常面临的事情，由于他们的肤色、历史、背景、语言或宗教，

sentences.en: do because of the color of their skin or their history or their origins or their language or their religion face on a regular basis.
sentences.zh: 有太多人正经历着这种歧视。

sentences.en: And I didn't see that from the layers of privilege that I have.
sentences.zh: 而我从自己享有的种种特权中没有看到这一点。

sentences.en: And for that, I am deeply sorry and I apologize.
sentences.zh: 为此，我感到深深的愧疚并致以歉意。

sentences.en: Trudeau, an outspoken liberal, apologized for the incidents.
sentences.zh: 作为一名直言不讳的自由派人士，特鲁多为这些事件道了歉。

sentences.en: But his rival in the campaign, Conservative Party leader Andrew Scheer, called it evidence that Trudeau is not who he says he is.
sentences.zh: 但他在竞选中的对手、保守党领袖安德鲁·舍尔称，这证明了特鲁多并非他所标榜的那样。

sentences.en: For decades, the Brooklyn Democratic Party operated as a tightly controlled machine.
sentences.zh: 几十年来，布鲁克林民主党一直作为一个受严密控制的机器在运作。

sentences.en: Until this summer.
sentences.zh: 直到今年夏天。

sentences.en: When elections ushered in a bunch of self-described reformers.
sentences.zh: 当时选举迎来了群自称改革派的人。

sentences.en: Ever since, the party has been in the grip of a bruising, chaotic, and sometimes thrilling fight.
sentences.zh: 自那以后，该党一直陷入一场残酷、混乱、有时令人惊心动魄的争斗中。
